beliefs: f is well approximated by a single straight line f(x)≈4.7093*x+3.92 across the whole range, with no real kink [E11, E12, E1, E2]
The apparent 'kink' near zero is a small smooth nonlinearity (a slight S-curve/dip) rather than two distinct lines [E12, E10, E5]
The far-field slope is ~4.7093 per unit and intercept ~3.92, confirmed at |x| up to 127 [E11]
Near zero, f is slightly below the global line on the negative side and slightly above on the positive side, i.e. a smooth transition of width ~1-2 units [E12, E10]
The exact functional form of the near-zero smooth transition is not yet pinned down; a small tanh-like correction around x=0 fits best so far [E12]?
notes: E11 shows a single global line fits far field exactly; E12 shows near-zero is a smooth monotone curve, not a sharp kink. Replaced two-line model with global line plus a small smooth tanh correction centered at 0.
